text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains. Try to avoid too much sugar and fast food. Second, exercise regularly. Even a short walk every day can help you feel better and stay fit. Third, get enough sleep, because your body needs rest to work well. Don't forget mental health, too. Talk to friends or family when you feel stressed. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance. Make time for hobbies and relax. These simple habits can make your life happier and healthier.
